scope: Main condensed record of independent Luna round2; exact current screenshots and measurements are hashed in checkpoint.json

findings.summary: Eave weight, gate layers and tile material remain weaker than target.
evidence: screen.png: roofMid x350 y60 w530 has fixed margins; beam x501 y210 w468 remains flat; left/right roof underside is thin.
findings.recommendation: Preserve transparent roof margins; increase eave thickness and layered brackets in a future art iteration.

findings.summary: Overall depth remains insufficient; local near facade risks losing readable edges.
evidence: Same large near region luma18.21 versus reference8.31; middle foreground33.28 versus24.55; lower foreground21.78 versus10.61.
findings.recommendation: Use directional highlights and local contrast; lower blue fill in foreground while keeping distance fog.

findings.summary: Balcony and distant facade remain too flat; bright arch is partly occluded.
evidence: nearFacade x-37 y168 w376 h517; midFacade x1313 y377 w291 h452; horizontal platform y571 masks part of arch.
findings.recommendation: Deepen balcony projection and rebalance arch visibility and wall brightness.

findings.summary: Central cloth and market layers remain shallower and less dense than target.
evidence: clothCenter x681 y488 w464 h193; its natural contour remains at roughly649–680 versus deeper target layers.
findings.recommendation: Further art design needed for sag, rear cloth, ropes and occlusion.

findings.summary: Lamp distribution improved but local height/width still differ.
evidence: Left body x182..239 y250..306 is slightly wide/low; right body y301..337 improved; middle lights high and low foreground lamp still low.
findings.recommendation: Future local lamp tuning; keep dynamic grapple circles out of environment art.
